# Captain v2 Current Status

Last updated: 2026-03-31

## Purpose
Rolling status for quick resume of Captain-v2 development.

## Firmware Snapshot
- Shared source tree: `Captain-v2/`
- Board-specific projects:
	- `Captain-v2-control/`
	- `Captain-v2-matrix/`
- Current active development target: matrix board

## Matrix Board Protocol Snapshot (Current)
- I2C address: `0x24`
- Command bytes:
	- `0x20/0x21` system off/on
	- `0x80/0x81` output off/on
	- `0xE0..0xEF` pulse-width level (0..15)
- Register windows:
	- Lamp RAM `0x00..0x07`
	- Switch bytes `0x40..0x43`
	- Diagnostics `0xF0..0xF3`
- Default pulse-width level: `4` (250 us row dwell)

## Matrix Test Segmentation
- Test support module is isolated for easy removal:
	- `include/matrix_test_support.h`
	- `src/matrix_test_support.cpp`
- Build flag in matrix project currently enables it:
	- `CAPTAIN_MATRIX_TEST_SUPPORT=1`
